what.text: This page follows refugees from Burkina Faso living in Togo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 45144 Burkinabe refugees in Togo, 12.9% of all refugees from Burkina Faso.
Mali hosts the most Burkinabe refugees, followed by Côte d'Ivoire, Togo and Ghana.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burkina Faso with JNIM from 2018 to 2025, at war level in some of those years.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Burkina Faso from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2023 at 19327 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Togo.
These are year-end totals for Togo only, reported to UNHCR.
